noun_definition: Tag rule refers to a set of conditions that govern the behavior of tags in the system, which are expected to be unavailable for multi tags when the rules are not present on Old Dot.
Multi tag refers to a tagging structure that includes both main tags and sub tags, which is subject to specific rules that are not applicable in the context of Old Dot.
Rule refers to a set of conditions or guidelines that govern the availability of tag functionalities for multi tags in the context of the application being discussed.
Old dot refers to the previous version of the system where tag rules are not implemented for multi tags.
